Your submission must be a genuine reimplementation. The provided `./executable` is for

# igrep

igrep is an interactive search tool that runs a fast search engine in the background and allows you to pick results interactively and open the selected match in your text editor.

Supported platforms: macOS, Linux (Windows reportedly supported).

Usage
-----
ig [OPTIONS] <PATTERN|--type-list> [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  <PATTERN>    Regular expression used for searching.
  <PATHS>...   Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively.
               If not specified, searching starts from current directory.

Options (high level):
  --hidden                    Search hidden files and directories.
  --editor <EDITOR>           Text editor used to open selected match.
  --context-viewer <VIEWER>   Context viewer position at startup [default: none]
  --custom-command <COMMAND>  Custom command used to open selected match. Must contain {file_name} and {line_number} tokens.
  -g, --glob <GLOB>           Include files/directories matching the given glob.
  -h, --help                  Print help information
  -i, --ignore-case           Searches case insensitively.
  -L, --follow                Follow symbolic links while traversing directories
  -S, --smart-case            Smart case sensitivity behavior
  -t, --type <TYPE>           Only search files matching TYPE
  -T, --type-not <TYPE>       Do not search files matching TYPE
  --theme <THEME>             UI color theme [default: dark]
  --type-list                 Show all supported file types and their corresponding globs.
  -V, --version               Print version information.
  -w, --word-regexp           Only show matches surrounded by word boundaries
  -F, --fixed-strings         Exact matches with no regex

Keybindings
-----------
q, Esc, Ctrl+c      Quit
? / F1              Open/close the keymap popup
Down / j            Select next match
Up / k              Select previous match
Right / l           Select match in next file
Left / h            Select match in previous file
gg / Home           Jump to the first match
Shift-g / End       Jump to the last match
Enter               Open current file
dd / Delete         Filter out selected match
dw                  Filter out all matches in current file
v                   Toggle vertical context viewer
s                   Toggle horizontal context viewer
+ / -               Increase/decrease context viewer size
F5 / /              Open search pattern popup
n / m / c / a       Sorting and navigation shortcuts

Specifying text editor
----------------------
Order of precedence when selecting editor:
  1. --editor option
  2. $IGREP_EDITOR environment variable
  3. $VISUAL environment variable
  4. $EDITOR environment variable

Custom command example:
  --custom-command "vim +{line_number} {file_name}"
  or set via environment: IGREP_CUSTOM_EDITOR="vim +{line_number} {file_name}"

Installation
------------
Prebuilt binaries are available from the project releases.
Package managers:
  - Homebrew: `brew install igrep`
  - Scoop: `scoop install igrep`
  - Pacman (Arch): `pacman -S igrep`
  - Alpine: `apk add igrep`

License
-------
See the LICENSE file in this repository for license information.

    master, slave = pty.openpty()

        stdin=slave,

import subprocess, os, pty, select, time, sys, signal, termios, tty, struct, fcntl

def run_with_pty_and_input(args, send_keys, timeout=3, cols=120, rows=40):
    master, slave = pty.openpty()
    # set window size
    s = struct.pack("HHHH", rows, cols, 0, 0)
    fcntl.ioctl(slave, termios.TIOCSWINSZ, s)
    proc = subprocess.Popen(
        args,
        stdin=slave,
        stdout=slave,
        stderr=slave,
        close_fds=True,
        env={**os.environ, "TERM": "xterm-256color", "COLORTERM":"truecolor"},
        preexec_fn=os.setsid
    )
    os.close(slave)
    out = b''
    start = time.time()
    sent_idx = 0
    # we will send keys with delays
    # For now, wait a bit then send
    time.sleep(0.5)
    for chunk in send_keys:
        if isinstance(chunk, str):
            os.write(master, chunk.encode())
        else:
            # bytes
            os.write(master, chunk)
        time.sleep(0.3)
        # read available
        while True:
            r, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.1)
            if master in r:
                try:
                    d = os.read(master, 8192)
                    if not d: break
                    out += d
                except: break
            else: break

    # final read for a bit
    end = time.time() + 1.5
    while time.time() < end:
        r, _, _ = select.select([master], [], [], 0.2)
        if master in r:
            try:
                d=os.read(master, 4096)
                if not d: break
                out+=d
            except: break
        if proc.poll() is not None:
            break
    # cleanup
    try:
        os.killpg(os.getpgid(proc.pid), signal.SIGTERM)
    except: pass
    try: proc.wait(timeout=1)
    except: proc.kill()
    os.close(master)
    return out, proc.returncode

# igrep

igrep is an interactive search tool that runs a fast search engine in the background and allows you to pick results interactively and open the selected match in your text editor.

Supported platforms: macOS, Linux (Windows reportedly supported).

Usage
-----
ig [OPTIONS] <PATTERN|--type-list> [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  <PATTERN>    Regular expression used for searching.
  <PATHS>...   Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively.
               If not specified, searching starts from current directory.

Options (high level):
  --hidden                    Search hidden files and directories.
  --editor <EDITOR>           Text editor used to open selected match.
  --context-viewer <VIEWER>   Context viewer position at startup [default: none]
  --custom-command <COMMAND>  Custom command used to open selected match. Must contain {file_name} and {line_number} tokens.
  -g, --glob <GLOB>           Include files/directories matching the given glob.
  -h, --help                  Print help information
  -i, --ignore-case           Searches case insensitively.
  -L, --follow                Follow symbolic links while traversing directories
  -S, --smart-case            Smart case sensitivity behavior
  -t, --type <TYPE>           Only search files matching TYPE
  -T, --type-not <TYPE>       Do not search files matching TYPE
  --theme <THEME>             UI color theme [default: dark]
  --type-list                 Show all supported file types and their corresponding globs.
  -V, --version               Print version information.
  -w, --word-regexp           Only show matches surrounded by word boundaries
  -F, --fixed-strings         Exact matches with no regex

Keybindings
-----------
q, Esc, Ctrl+c      Quit
? / F1              Open/close the keymap popup
Down / j            Select next match
Up / k              Select previous match
Right / l           Select match in next file
Left / h            Select match in previous file
gg / Home           Jump to the first match
Shift-g / End       Jump to the last match
Enter               Open current file
dd / Delete         Filter out selected match
dw                  Filter out all matches in current file
v                   Toggle vertical context viewer
s                   Toggle horizontal context viewer
+ / -               Increase/decrease context viewer size
F5 / /              Open search pattern popup
n / m / c / a       Sorting and navigation shortcuts

Specifying text editor
----------------------
Order of precedence when selecting editor:
  1. --editor option
  2. $IGREP_EDITOR environment variable
  3. $VISUAL environment variable
  4. $EDITOR environment variable

Custom command example:
  --custom-command "vim +{line_number} {file_name}"
  or set via environment: IGREP_CUSTOM_EDITOR="vim +{line_number} {file_name}"

Installation
------------
Prebuilt binaries are available from the project releases.
Package managers:
  - Homebrew: `brew install igrep`
  - Scoop: `scoop install igrep`
  - Pacman (Arch): `pacman -S igrep`
  - Alpine: `apk add igrep`

# igrep

igrep is an interactive search tool that runs a fast search engine in the background and allows you to pick results interactively and open the selected match in your text editor.

Supported platforms: macOS, Linux (Windows reportedly supported).

Usage
-----
ig [OPTIONS] <PATTERN|--type-list> [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  <PATTERN>    Regular expression used for searching.
  <PATHS>...   Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively.
               If not specified, searching starts from current directory.

Options (high level):
  --hidden                    Search hidden files and directories.
  --editor <EDITOR>           Text editor used to open selected match.
  --context-viewer <VIEWER>   Context viewer position at startup [default: none]
  --custom-command <COMMAND>  Custom command used to open selected match. Must contain {file_name} and {line_number} tokens.
  -g, --glob <GLOB>           Include files/directories matching the given glob.
  -h, --help                  Print help information
  -i, --ignore-case           Searches case insensitively.
  -L, --follow                Follow symbolic links while traversing directories
  -S, --smart-case            Smart case sensitivity behavior
  -t, --type <TYPE>           Only search files matching TYPE
  -T, --type-not <TYPE>       Do not search files matching TYPE
  --theme <THEME>             UI color theme [default: dark]
  --type-list                 Show all supported file types and their corresponding globs.
  -V, --version               Print version information.
  -w, --word-regexp           Only show matches surrounded by word boundaries
  -F, --fixed-strings         Exact matches with no regex

Keybindings
-----------
q, Esc, Ctrl+c      Quit
? / F1              Open/close the keymap popup
Down / j            Select next match
Up / k              Select previous match
Right / l           Select match in next file
Left / h            Select match in previous file
gg / Home           Jump to the first match
Shift-g / End       Jump to the last match
Enter               Open current file
dd / Delete         Filter out selected match
dw                  Filter out all matches in current file
v                   Toggle vertical context viewer
s                   Toggle horizontal context viewer
+ / -               Increase/decrease context viewer size
F5 / /              Open search pattern popup
n / m / c / a       Sorting and navigation shortcuts

Specifying text editor
----------------------
Order of precedence when selecting editor:
  1. --editor option
  2. $IGREP_EDITOR environment variable
  3. $VISUAL environment variable
  4. $EDITOR environment variable

Custom command example:
  --custom-command "vim +{line_number} {file_name}"
  or set via environment: IGREP_CUSTOM_EDITOR="vim +{line_number} {file_name}"

Installation
------------
Prebuilt binaries are available from the project releases.
Package managers:
  - Homebrew: `brew install igrep`
  - Scoop: `scoop install igrep`
  - Pacman (Arch): `pacman -S igrep`
  - Alpine: `apk add igrep`

/*!
The types module provides a way of associating globs on file names to file
types.

This can be used to match specific types of files. For example, among
the default file types provided, the Rust file type is defined to be `*.rs`
with name `rust`. Similarly, the C file type is defined to be `*.{c,h}` with
name `c`.

Note that the set of default types may change over time.

# Example

This shows how to create and use a simple file type matcher using the default
file types defined in this crate.

```
use ignore::types::TypesBuilder;

let mut builder = TypesBuilder::new();
builder.add_defaults();
builder.select("rust");
let matcher = builder.build().unwrap();

assert!(matcher.matched("foo.rs", false).is_whitelist());
assert!(matcher.matched("foo.c", false).is_ignore());
```

# Example: negation

This is like the previous example, but shows how negating a file type works.
That is, this will let us match file paths that *don't* correspond to a
particular file type.

```
use ignore::types::TypesBuilder;

let mut builder = TypesBuilder::new();
builder.add_defaults();
builder.negate("c");
let matcher = builder.build().unwrap();

assert!(matcher.matched("foo.rs", false).is_none());
assert!(matcher.matched("foo.c", false).is_ignore());
```

# Example: custom file type definitions

This shows how to extend this library default file type definitions with
your own.

```
use ignore::types::TypesBuilder;

let mut builder = TypesBuilder::new();
builder.add_defaults();
builder.add("foo", "*.foo");
// Another way of adding a file type definition.
// This is useful when accepting input from an end user.
builder.add_def("bar:*.bar");
// Note: we only select `foo`, not `bar`.
builder.select("foo");
let matcher = builder.build().unwrap();

assert!(matcher.matched("x.foo", false).is_whitelist());
// This is ignored because we only selected the `foo` file type.
assert!(matcher.matched("x.bar", false).is_ignore());
```

We can also add file type definitions based on other definitions.

```
use ignore::types::TypesBuilder;

let mut builder = TypesBuilder::new();
builder.add_defaults();
builder.add("foo", "*.foo");
builder.add_def("bar:include:foo,cpp");
builder.select("bar");
let matcher = builder.build().unwrap();

assert!(matcher.matched("x.foo", false).is_whitelist());
assert!(matcher.matched("y.cpp", false).is_whitelist());
```

# igrep

igrep is an interactive search tool that runs a fast search engine in the background and allows you to pick results interactively and open the selected match in your text editor.

Supported platforms: macOS, Linux (Windows reportedly supported).

Usage
-----
ig [OPTIONS] <PATTERN|--type-list> [PATHS]...

Arguments:
  <PATTERN>    Regular expression used for searching.
  <PATHS>...   Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively.
               If not specified, searching starts from current directory.

Options (high level):
  --hidden                    Search hidden files and directories.
  --editor <EDITOR>           Text editor used to open selected match.
  --context-viewer <VIEWER>   Context viewer position at startup [default: none]
  --custom-command <COMMAND>  Custom command used to open selected match. Must contain {file_name} and {line_number} tokens.

use std::io::IsTerminal;
use clap::{Arg, ArgAction, Command};

fn build_cmd() -> Command {
    Command::new("igrep").bin_name("executable")
        .version("1.3.0")
        .about("Interactive Grep")
        .arg(Arg::new("pattern").value_name("PATTERN").help("Regular expression used for searching").required(true).conflicts_with("type-list"))
        .arg(Arg::new("paths").value_name("PATHS").help("Files or directories to search. Directories are searched recursively. If not specified, searching starts from current directory").num_args(0..))
        .arg(Arg::new("editor").long("editor").value_name("EDITOR").help("Text editor used to open selected match").value_parser(["vim","neovim","nvim","nano","code","vscode","code-insiders","emacs","emacsclient","hx","helix","subl","sublime-text","micro","intellij","goland","pycharm","less","fresh"]).conflicts_with("custom-command"))
        .arg(Arg::new("custom-command").long("custom-command").value_name("CUSTOM_COMMAND").help("Custom command used to open selected match. Must contain {file_name} and {line_number} tokens").env("IGREP_CUSTOM_EDITOR").conflicts_with("editor"))
        .arg(Arg::new("theme").long("theme").value_name("THEME").help("UI color theme").default_value("dark").value_parser(["light","dark"]))
        .arg(Arg::new("ignore-case").short('i').long("ignore-case").help("Searches case insensitively").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("smart-case").short('S').long("smart-case").help("Searches case insensitively if the pattern is all lowercase. Search case sensitively otherwise").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("hidden").short('.').long("hidden").help("Search hidden files and directories. By default, hidden files and directories are skipped").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("follow").short('L').long("follow").help("Follow symbolic links while traversing directories").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("word-regexp").short('w').long("word-regexp").help("Only show matches surrounded by word boundaries").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("fixed-strings").short('F').long("fixed-strings").help("Exact matches with no regex. Useful when searching for a string full of delimiters").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("multiline").short('U').long("multiline").help("Search with pattern contains newline character ('\\n')").action(ArgAction::SetTrue))
        .arg(Arg::new("glob").short('g').long("glob").value_name("GLOB").help("Include files and directories for searching that match the given glob. Multiple globs may be provided").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("type-list").long("type-list").help("Show all supported file types and their corresponding globs").action(ArgAction::SetTrue).required(true))
        .arg(Arg::new("type").short('t').long("type").value_name("TYPE_MATCHING").help("Only search files matching TYPE. Multiple types may be provided").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("type-not").short('T').long("type-not").value_name("TYPE_NOT").help("Do not search files matching TYPE-NOT. Multiple types-not may be provided").action(ArgAction::Append))
        .arg(Arg::new("context-viewer").long("context-viewer").value_name("CONTEXT_VIEWER").help("Context viewer position at startup").default_value("none").value_parser(["none","vertical","horizontal"]))
        .arg(Arg::new("sort").long("sort").value_name("SORT_BY").help("Sort results, see ripgrep for details").value_parser(["path","modified","created","accessed"]))
        .arg(Arg::new("sortr").long("sortr").value_name("SORT_BY_REVERSE").help("Sort results reverse, see ripgrep for details").value_parser(["path","modified","created","accessed"]))
}

fn main() {
    let cmd = build_cmd();
    let matches = match cmd.try_get_matches_from(std::env::args()) {
        Ok(m) => m,
        Err(e) => {
            e.exit();
        }
    };
    if matches.get_flag("type-list") {
        let types = include_str!("../assets_typelist_reference.txt");
        print!("{}", types);
        return;
    }
    if let Some(cmd_str) = matches.get_one::<String>("custom-command") {
        let count_file = cmd_str.matches("{file_name}").count();
        let count_line = cmd_str.matches("{line_number}").count();
        if count_file != 1 {
            eprintln!("Error: Incorrect editor command: '{}'\n\nCaused by:\n    Expected one occurrence of '{{file_name}}'.", cmd_str);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
        if count_line != 1 {
            eprintln!("Error: Incorrect editor command: '{}'\n\nCaused by:\n    Expected one occurrence of '{{line_number}}'.", cmd_str);
            std::process::exit(1);
        }
    }
    if !std::io::stdout().is_terminal() || !std::io::stdin().is_terminal() {
        eprintln!("Error: Resource temporarily unavailable (os error 11)");
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
    if let Err(e) = run_app(matches) {
        eprintln!("Error: {}", e);
        std::process::exit(1);
    }
}

fn run_app(matches: clap::ArgMatches) -> anyhow::Result<()> {
    let pattern = matches.get_one::<String>("pattern").unwrap().clone();

use anyhow::Result;
use std::path::{Path, PathBuf};

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct Match {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub line_number: usize, // 1-indexed
    pub line: String,
    pub match_start: usize,
    pub match_end: usize,
}

#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
pub struct FileMatches {
    pub path: PathBuf,
    pub matches: Vec<Match>,
}

pub fn search(
    pattern: &str,
    paths: &[String],
    ignore_case: bool,
    smart_case: bool,
    hidden: bool,
    follow: bool,
    word_regexp: bool,
    fixed_strings: bool,
    multiline: bool,
    globs: &[String],
    types: &[String],
    type_not: &[String],
    sort: &Option<String>,
    sortr: &Option<String>,
) -> Result<Vec<FileMatches>> {
    // Build regex
    let mut regex_pattern = pattern.to_string();
    if fixed_strings {

fn sort_matches(all: &mut Vec<FileMatches>, sort_key: &str, reverse: bool) -> Result<()> {
    match sort_key {
        "path" => {
            all.sort_by(|a,b| a.path.cmp(&b.path));
        },
        "modified" => {
            all.sort_by(|a,b| {
                let a_m = std::fs::metadata(&a.path).and_then(|m| m.modified()).unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
                let b_m = std::fs::metadata(&b.path).and_then(|m| m.modified()).unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
                a_m.cmp(&b_m)
            });
        },
        "created" => {
            all.sort_by(|a,b| {
                let a_c = std::fs::metadata(&a.path).and_then(|m| m.created()).unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
                let b_c = std::fs::metadata(&b.path).and_then(|m| m.created()).unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
                a_c.cmp(&b_c)
            });
        },
        "accessed" => {
            all.sort_by(|a,b| {
                let a_a = std::fs::metadata(&a.path).and_then(|m| m.accessed()).unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
                let b_a = std::fs::metadata(&b.path).and_then(|m| m.accessed()).unwrap_or(std::time::SystemTime::UNIX_EPOCH);
                a_a.cmp(&b_a)
            });
        },
        _ => {}
    }
    if reverse {
        all.reverse();
    }
    // Also need to sort matches within each file by line number
    for fm in all.iter_mut() {
        fm.matches.sort_by_key(|m| m.line_number);
    }
    Ok(())
}

    server=libtmux.Server()
    for s in server.sessions:
        if s.session_name.startswith("keytest"):
            try: s.kill()
            except: pass
    session=server.new_session(session_name="keytest", attach=False, window_command="bash")
    pane=session.windows[0].panes[0]
    time.sleep(0.6)
    subprocess.run(["tmux","resize-window","-t","keytest","-x","120","-y","30"])
    pane.cmd("resize-pane","-x","120","-y","30")
    time.sleep(0.3)
    tmpdir="/tmp/igtest_dq02wbiy"
    pane.send_keys(f'{binary} hello {tmpdir}')
    time.sleep(1.2)
    for k in keys:
        subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t","keytest", k])
        time.sleep(0.6)
    out=subprocess.run(["tmux","capture-pane","-t","keytest","-p"], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    subprocess.run(["tmux","send-keys","-t","keytest","q"])
    time.sleep(0.3)
    server.kill_session("keytest")
    return out

  -g, --glob <GLOB>           Include files/directories matching the given glob.

  -T, --type-not <TYPE>       Do not search files matching TYPE
